--- Page 1 ---
OPERATIVE REPORT

Patient: John Doe  DOB: 01/15/1965
Date of Surgery: 03/10/2024

PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: Acute appendicitis

PROCEDURE PERFORMED: Laparoscopic appendectomy

OPERATIVE FINDINGS: The patient was placed in the supine position under general anesthesia.
Three laparoscopic ports were inserted. The appendix was identified and found to be acutely
inflamed. The mesoappendix was divided and the appendix was resected at its base using
an endoscopic stapler. Specimen was removed via an endoscopic bag.

--- Page 2 ---
POSTOPERATIVE NOTE

Patient tolerated the procedure well. No complications noted. Estimated blood loss was
minimal. Patient was transferred to recovery room in stable condition.

Surgeon: Dr. Jane Smith, MD
